ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability, not task preference. The query is a benign creative-writing task (drafting a job description), so the harm-adjacent preference differences between the models don't apply. Comparing measured ability, Petrel scores meaningfully higher on the relevant Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 78.8 — well beyond the 2.0-point variance threshold) and leads across all public benchmarks, so it's the stronger choice for producing a polished, usable result.
